# Terra Invicta Companion

> Free, unofficial second-screen companion for the strategy game Terra Invicta (Pavonis Interactive). It runs entirely in the browser (Chrome or Edge on desktop), reads the player's save files from a folder they choose, and puts nations, councilors, missions, factions, space assets and technologies side by side. It only shows what the game already shows the player: it is a reading tool, not a cheat.

Site: https://terrainvicta-companion.b4p3p.it/

## What it shows

- Alerts: rules checked on every save, what changed since the previous one.
- Council: attribute coverage, missions nobody on the council can run, which recruit candidates would cover them.
- Missions: the real attacking and defending factors of each mission from the game templates; targets ranked with raw values next to the score.
- Nations: trends over time and a detail view per nation.
- Factions: rival factions and councilors compared only on what the player's intel unlocks.
- Space: visible habitats, Earth orbits with free slots, buildable modules and when they are affordable.
- Technologies: what each available technology unlocks for the player's faction.
- Presets: custom priority presets as files to copy into the game, without mods, so achievements stay enabled.
- History: every save archived, turn-to-turn differences, goals and notes, exportable.
- Game terms in all 14 languages of the game, from its official localization.

## How it works

1. Open the site in Chrome or Edge on the PC where Terra Invicta is installed.
2. Choose My Games or TerraInvicta inside Documents; the companion finds the Saves folder.
3. It reloads automatically on every save. The first visit downloads about 13 MB (Python compiled to WebAssembly).

## Facts

- Not a cheat: real councilor loyalty, intel the player hasn't gathered and rival missions during the mission phase stay hidden. Computed scores are labelled as such, with raw values shown.
- Saves are never uploaded; no account, no tracking scripts.
- Never writes to save files.
- Firefox and Safari are not supported (no File System Access API).
- Free, no ads, optional donations. Fan project, not affiliated with Pavonis Interactive or Hooded Horse.
- Interface in English and Italian.
